thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SLO_BURN alert: service=redwood-inference-api env=prod burn_rate=15.2 (10m window) — paging criteria met. Triggering page to #eng-oncall.
Anne L: On call, looking. Any customer-facing errors?
Raj P: I'm seeing an uptick of 429s from the routing layer around 09:12 UTC, likely queue overflow. Pulling logs.
Sarah M: Confirmed, a few tenants show degraded tail latency + 5xx spike (502/504). Correlating with a large batch job?
Miguel C: Checking autoscaler logs — no new scale events since 09:05, requests spiked, pools saturated.
Anne L: Miguel, can you temporarily increase pool size or open a burst slot? We need immediate mitigation if it's customer impacting.
Miguel C: Increasing pool by 2 nodes now (will take ~45s).
Olivia K: Noted multiple similar alerts in last 24h but shorter duration — could be noisy. Might be false-positive for small bursts.
Jen T: For now, are customers actually impacted? Any support tickets?
Raj P: No public incidents in Zendesk yet. But error budget burn is high for a few enterprise tenants. Dashboard shows sustained burn across 3m and 10m windows.
Anne L: Miguel — pool up?
Miguel C: Pool up + routing backpressure reduced. 429s dropping.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Autoscaler: pool_resize complete at 09:16:28 UTC.
Sarah M: Latency returning to baseline in us-west. Still seeing a small tail in eu-central.
Olivia K: Suggest we mute the immediate SLO_BURN page and adjust paging criteria after triage. Paging is firing on 10m window only — too sensitive for transient traffic surges.
Anne L: Agreed. Let's mute the current page and create a follow-up to tune the alert. I'll mute 30m and note in thread.
Anne L: /incident mute SLO_BURN 30m — doing it now.
incident-bot: :information_source: Page muted by Anne L for 30m. Reason: ongoing mitigation and transient traffic spike.
Raj P: Post-mortem quick notes: root cause was a background data-export job hitting inference routes (misrouted). Fixing routing rule to isolate control-plane jobs from customer traffic.
Sarah M: For the alert tuning: propose multi-window logic: require burn_rate > threshold on both 3m and 10m windows OR burn_rate > higher threshold on single 30m window. That should cut flap pages.
Olivia K: Also add a customer-impact gating condition: only page when `customer_error_rate > 0.5%` OR `enterprise_affected = true`. Saves paging for internal churn.
Jen T: Good. Can we add a temporary suppression for the specific tenant until their export completes?
Raj P: Yes, added route filter to exclude control-job tenant: `route != "control-export"` — pushed as hotfix.
Anne L: After-action items: 1) Update paging rule, 2) Create dashboard that shows multi-window burn and affected-tenants list, 3) Run a synthetic canary to validate.
Miguel C: I'll open PR for alert rule change. Snippet: 
``` 
alert: SLO_Burn_Paging
expr: (burn_3m > 8 and burn_10m > 6) or (burn_30m > 12)
for: 2m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: "SLO burn high on {{ $labels.service }}"
``` 
I'll include gating by `customer_error_rate > 0.005` in the templated query.
Sarah M: Add a non-paging severity for single-window flaps so we still create an ops ticket but don't page immediately.
Olivia K: I'll build the dashboard tile and wire the affected-tenants query. Will add a toggle to view raw vs. filtered traffic.
Jen T: Support: I'll notify CS for the handful of enterprise tenants to preempt questions.
Anne L: Thanks. Quick post-incident risk note: we relied on pool resize which bought us time — autoscaler rules need an emergency burst policy. Add as A2.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Follow-up created: #INC-1874 "SLO paging tuning & burst policy" assigned to eng-sre.
Raj P: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/alerts/pull/482 — includes rule + unit tests for multi-window.
Miguel C: After this, propose we change default page to only fire when both multi-window and customer-impact gates pass OR when burn sustained > 20 for 30m (emergency). That should reduce noise while keeping safety.
Anne L: Sounds right. Let's reconvene in the postmortem tomorrow. For now, thumbs up for suppression + hotfix. :thumbsup:
Sarah M: Thanks team — I'll start the incident write-up with timeline and attach logs.
Olivia K: Dashboard draft link: https://dashboards.internal/redwood/slo-burn-multiwindow (WIP)
Jen T: CS notified via ticket #CS-3341.
Anne L: Closing coordination in this thread. Keep updates in the ticket/PR for traceability.
Olivia K: :eyes: will follow up with dashboard and alert tests.
Raj P: Marking incident resolved on monitoring side; continue watch for 2 hours.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. Duration: 14m.
Anne L: End.
